summary: Reproduced that the shared OpenAI serving prompt router selected text solely because the checkpoint was multimodal, even when a text-only request already had prompt token IDs. Updated the shared router used by chat completions and responses to reuse usable IDs for text-only requests while retaining text routing for actual image/video/audio payloads and empty IDs, the raw-string fallback, and token-first encoder behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: The untouched source routed a multimodal-capable text-only request with prompt_ids [11, 12, 13] as text; the regression failed with ('text', 'rendered prompt') instead of ('input_ids', [11, 12, 13]). The independent media, empty-ID, and token-first boundaries passed; the string fallback ordering also failed before the fix. Raw log: reports/j-1d2be600c7d4/raw/failing-before-engine-prompt.log

140 chat serving tests passed, including text-only ID reuse plus image, video, audio, empty-ID, string-ID, and Inkling token-first boundaries. Raw log: reports/j-1d2be600c7d4/raw/passing-after-serving-chat-full.log

36 responses serving tests passed, including endpoint-level verification that a text-only request on a multimodal-capable checkpoint forwards [7, 8, 9] rather than the rendered string, while actual media remains on the text path. Raw log: reports/j-1d2be600c7d4/raw/passing-after-serving-responses-full.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, secrets, and registered-test checks passed. Raw log: reports/j-1d2be600c7d4/raw/pre-commit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced defect and correction are in CPU-side OpenAI request prompt selection. No Qwen3.5-122B weights or equivalent multimodal checkpoint were available; an unrelated GPU smoke would not validate the eliminated host tokenization path.

remaining_limitations: No full Qwen3.5-122B, TP4, 100k-262k context, or production traffic replay was performed, so the reported TTFT percentages were not independently reproduced.
No model weights were used. Tests deterministically validate routing and preservation of prompt IDs, not model semantics or end-to-end latency.
The assigned single gfx950 GPU was not used because this correction is before engine/GPU execution and the reported model requires a different multi-GPU setup.
